notes.title: Big Update: New Features Added!
notes.notes:
🚀 New Features Update! 🚀

🆕 Level System: Earn a Jar of Luck as a reward each time you level up! 

🎯 Daily Quests: Take on new daily challenges and unlock awesome rewards! 

💡 Hover Info: Get detailed info on items by hovering over them for quick tips and insights! 

💥 Buff Gifts: Collect special buffs while playing to boost your performance and increase your chances of success! 🎉
